catalog_app_shopify_description: Connect Shopify stores to read orders, products, inventory, and fulfillment.
catalog_app_jtl_description: Connect JTL Cloud or JTL-Wawi to read commerce data, correct shipping methods, send approved purchase orders, and create approved returns.
catalog_app_cin7_description: Connect Cin7 Core to read orders, fulfillments, credit notes, products, stock, customers, and purchasing.
catalog_app_gmail_description: Connect Gmail mailboxes to read supplier and customer messages that match your inbox rules, and send approved replies.
catalog_app_starshipit_description: Read shipping orders and carrier tracking, and review unshipped order corrections.
